format: Each step: dir (host->device | device->host), endpoint (bulk_out=EP 0x03, bulk_in=EP 0x82, interrupt_in=EP 0x81, 16-byte packets), hex (exact bytes of one USB transfer), annotation. provenance: 'verhue-capture' = hex dump found in Verhue's sources (probably captured from the official editor), 'clavia-derived' = built from the Clavia v1.62 serializers, 'verhue-derived' = built from Verhue's builders, 'synthetic' = device reply invented to match the decoded layout (field values arbitrary but legal).
description: Edit bubbles captured from Clavia's editor on a real G2X (molecule bytes), for the order of a cable's ends, the dump bit and the grouping of molecules in one bubble.

steps.annotation: A new cable: 50, flags 0x19 (not part of a dump, VA, blue), module 1 output 0 -> module 2 input 1: the drag's origin first (capture-011)
A new cable from an audio output (red) and the rate change it causes, one bubble: 50, then 2A VA module 2 uprate 1 (capture-011)
That cable deleted: 51, flags 0x03 (not part of a dump, VA), the child end (module 2 input 0) first, its parent (module 4 output 0) second; then 2A back to 0 (capture-011)
Undo of a paste (part): a pasted cable deleted as part of a dump (flags 0x01: the not-a-dump bit clear), then 32 VA module 8 (capture-010)
A pasted module: 30 type 0x61 (OscA), VA, index 5, column 1, row 15, colour 0, uprate 0, not locked, no modes, name (capture-009; its 52, 4D, 5B, 5A sections follow in the same bubble)
MIDI Learn: 22 VA module 1 parameter 7 -> CC 16, session 1 (a whole captured frame)
